title: Task-specific ionic liquids and ultrasound irradiation: a successful strategy to drive the alcoholysis of polycarbonate
content:

Depolymerization by the methanolysis of BPA-polycarbonate employing task-specific ionic liquids was performed under sonochemical conditions at 30 °C and was also tested on post-consumer samples.
